device.description: 20-bit bridge-sensor delta-sigma ADC with PGA (64/128), 10/80 SPS and 2-wire serial interface (DRDY/DOUT, SCLK)
device.note: ads1230.pdf (SBAS366B) p.3-4 electrical characteristics (data rate, logic levels, AVDD/DVDD 2.7-5.3 V), p.5 pin configuration and descriptions, p.13 data format (20 bits, Figure 24), data rate (Table 3), p.14-15 DRDY/DOUT, data retrieval timing (tPD = 50 ns, tCONV 12.5/100 ms), p.16-17 offset calibration, standby

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the SPEED / GAIN pin levels (pins.levels); SPEED 0 = 10 SPS, 1 = 80 SPS (p.5); no serial registers

pages: p.3-4 (EC), p.5 (pins), p.13 (data format, data rate), p.14-15 (DRDY/DOUT, retrieval timing), p.16-17 (calibration, standby)
notModeled: analog input, PGA gain (GAIN level stored only), reference
conversion time tCONV = 12.5 ms (SPEED = 1) / 100 ms (SPEED = 0) at fCLK = 4.9152 MHz (p.15); an external CLKIN (fCLK / 61,440 or / 491,520) scales it (CLKIN is not used)
SCLKs 21-24 output four 1s after the 20 data bits (Figure 24), modeled; after only 20 SCLKs DRDY/DOUT stays at the last bit until the update (modeled as idle 1)
offset calibration started by 26 SCLKs and standby mode (SCLK held high after DRDY/DOUT falls) and its wake-up
data-update window (no readback) and data overwritten if not read before the next update
PDWN low also resets the ADC (modeled as power-down only; there are no serial registers)
